cim: MVEDA to host advanced manufacturing conference in Las Cruces
cim_eredeti: MVEDA to host advanced manufacturing conference in Las Cruces
szoveg_eredeti:
The Jan. 13 event will explore automation, artificial intelligence and supply chain changes across the Borderplex region.

LAS CRUCES - The Mesilla Valley Economic Development Alliance will host its 2027 MVEDA Presents conference Jan. 13 at the Las Cruces Convention Center, focusing on automation, artificial intelligence, advanced manufacturing and changes in global supply chains.

The conference, titled "The Next Industrial Revolution," will examine how emerging technologies and industrial trends could shape economic development across the Borderplex region, which encompasses southern New Mexico, West Texas and northern Mexico.

Organizers are promoting the event under the theme "The Silent Shift Transforming the Borderplex Into North America's Advanced Manufacturing Hub."

The conference is scheduled from 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Wednesday, Jan. 13, 2027, at the Las Cruces Convention Center, 680 E. University Ave.

General admission costs $225. El Paso Electric Co. is the title sponsor.

MVEDA, the region's economic development organization, is directing prospective attendees and sponsors to MVEDApresents.com for additional information. Registration is also available online.

The announcement did not identify speakers, panelists or a detailed conference agenda.
